import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    high_corr_mask = np.abs(corr_matrix) >= 0.6
    np.fill_diagonal(high_corr_mask, False)
    
    # Find connected components in correlation graph
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(
        n_clusters=None, 
        distance_threshold=1-0.6,
        linkage='complete'
    )
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Select largest cluster as module
    unique_labels, counts = np.unique(cluster_labels, return_counts=True)
    if len(counts) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    largest_cluster = unique_labels[np.argmax(counts)]
    module_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) 
                       if cluster_labels[i] == largest_cluster]
    
    if len(module_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using first principal component
    module_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module_features]]
    _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(module_data, full_matrices=False)
    weights = vt[0] / np.linalg.norm(vt[0])
    loadings = dict(zip(module_features, weights))
    
    # Return design with module features and their loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=(module_features[0],),
        columns=tuple(module_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
